text:
Maria Chen: Hey SRE team — can someone drop links to the service-overview and model-health dashboards for eu-west? I'm trying to trace a latency spike around 2026-03-15 10:20 UTC and I don't have access to the model-health dash.
Jason Patel: Which service — inference-service or the router?
Maria Chen: inference-service (dedicated pool). spikes look like sudden p95 jumps.
Lee Gomez: I can paste links: service overview -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/service-overview?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west
Lee Gomez: model health -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/def456/model-health?orgId=1&var-model=redwood-v3
Maria Chen: clicking model-health gives 403 for me :frowning:
Lee Gomez: ah, you probably need the "read" role on infra/grafana/eu-west. @Sara can you grant Maria access?
Sara Nguyen: sure — what's Maria's SSO email?
Maria Chen: maria@redwood.ai
Sara Nguyen: granted read on the eu-west folder, should propagate in a couple mins.
Maria Chen: still 403 :confused:
Sara Nguyen: odd — are you using Okta groups? We prefer group grants (eng-eu). I'll check sync.
devex-bot: reminder: we prefer group-based grants. See https://docs.redwood.ai/devex/grafana-access for details.
Jason Patel: also try incognito to avoid stale SSO cookies.
Maria Chen: incognito worked, I can view everything now. thanks!
Maria Chen: quick Q — which panel shows per-region tail latency? I'm tuning an alert threshold.
Lee Gomez: panel is "p95 by region" in service-overview. Current alert is p95 > 400ms for 5m (we bumped from 300ms last month).
Maria Chen: SLO target is 300ms — we're seeing sustained bursts 360-380. Can we lower to 350?
Jason Patel: lowering risks a lot of noise. Consider changing evaluation window instead: p95 > 350 but over 15m, and add a model-variant filter.
Lee Gomez: agreed. Proposed: p95 > 350 for 15m with suppression for scheduled maintenance (30m). I'll open a PR to infra-alerts.
Maria Chen: please ping me the PR when ready.
Lee Gomez: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-alerts/pull/712
Maria Chen: noted, cc'ing oncall to watch for churn.
oncall-bot: @oncall assigned: tuesday-oncall
Sara Nguyen: re-ran permission sync and confirmed group membership; access should be stable now.
Maria Chen: closing the loop — I have access and saw the PR. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Lee Gomez: :rocket:
